OAT-06/S10.title: The per-day row through the screens: opens, timed encounter, regenerate, NH visits, wrong-zone device, local midnight
OAT-06/S10.detail: Local Playwright spec newspec-c/an2-oat06-s10-daily.spec.ts, two tests on brand-new accounts; every model call (generateNote, refreshCourseAndBackground, extractMedicationEvents, suggestBilling, parsePreRoundNotes) answered at the Convex socket. R1/R2 (judged items of the matrix oracle, 4/4 passed; their counting questions recorded): context 1 (real clock, Asia/Tokyo, day 2026-10-15): A opened twice and B once -> hospital preRoundSummariesOpened +2; Mark Encounter Complete on A 2+ minutes after its first open (a real wait) -> note_marked_complete with minutesFromPreRoundOpened 2, notesCompleted +1, encountersTimed +1, minutesPreRoundToComplete +2 (day average 2/1 = 2 min, readable from the row); B Generate -> note_generated and notesGenerated +1; Nursing Home visit 1 Generate -> note_generated against the resident, nursing_home notesGenerated +1. Recorded (Q16): A's two opens leave one pre_round_summary_opened row; B's Regenerate adds nothing (notesGenerated stays +1). Recorded (Q17): a second same-day Nursing Home visit (Pre-Round Save Note, then 'Regenerate Note') adds its own 'Visit 2 · Oct 15' course line but notesGenerated stays +1. R3/R4 judged against UAT 3.8 (Q3 still open with Daniela), 0/2: R3: a second browser context on the same account with timezoneId Pacific/Kiritimati and the clock 3 days ahead (it was signed out on load by the clock, B33; signing in through the real form under that clock worked) opened C and marked it complete: both rows carry day 2026-10-18 (the device's date) instead of context 1's 2026-10-15 and land in their own pilotDailyRounding row for 2026-10-18. R4: a context whose clock starts at 23:58 local opened D's Pre-Round (filed under 2026-10-14), the clock moved to 00:02 and Mark Encounter Complete was filed under 2026-10-15 with no minutesFromPreRoundOpened; encountersTimed stays 0 on both days although the server clock moved only seconds (one encounter split over two day rows, untimed). Cause (code read, matches): the analytics day is the device's localDay() (src/domain/localDay.ts, convex/lib/usage.ts), the same device-clock root cause as B18. U13 (providerMs / model of generateNote and suggestBilling) not re-run: the calls are answered in the browser here; the 10-15 review cites dev readings U43 / U44 / U68.
OAT-06/S10.productIssue: Nothing changes on the physician's screen, but the pilot's per-physician-per-day numbers follow each phone's own date and time zone: a phone set to another zone or the wrong date files its Pre-Round opens and completed notes under another day (a separate daily row), and an encounter opened before the phone's midnight and completed after it is split across two days and never timed, so Vikram's day totals and average Pre-Round-to-complete time are wrong (UAT 3.8).
